//: Per-version upgrade records applied by `update` to already-installed harnesses. Keys are released versions; each entry may carry: removed (stale template paths to delete when sha-unmodified), renamed (old path -> new path), promotedModules (opt-in modules folded into the default harness), configSteps (gate steps injected into the consumer's gate config: {name, cmd, after, array}; array defaults to VALIDATE_STEPS — the floor chain — and is 'STOP_HOOK_STEPS' for the non-floor turn-fatal checks. harness.config.mjs is SEEDED, so `update` never overwrites it: this injection is the ONLY way a new step reaches an existing install), configCommandUpdates (from-guarded canonical-command rewrites: {name, from, to}), seedOnInitOnly (NEW seeded exemplar paths a newer template ships as init-time-only starting content — `update` must NOT auto-plant them into an existing install; a trailing '/' matches the whole subtree, no slash matches an exact file; collected across ALL versions, not just pending, and pullable on demand via `update --refresh-seeded <path>`). Entries are applied in version order for manifest.harnessVersion < v <= installer version. See installer/lib/migrations.mjs.
